title.description: The name of the blood donation camp or drive.

location.description: Physical location or venue where the camp is held.

endDate.description: End date of the camp. (If it is a 1-day camp, make this the same as Start Date).

details.description: Any additional information or eligibility criteria for donors.

organizer.description: Name of the organization, college, or community group hosting the drive.

mapsLink.description: Google Maps URL for the venue.
